sources.title: Distinguishing Between
sources.quote: The main intention behind empathic exploration is to deepen exploration, and this is done by moving the exploration forward toward the leading edges of experience with a discovery-oriented, querying tone.
sources.technique: When a client shares distress, first respond with empathic understanding or validation, then use a curious, discovery-oriented reflection to explore the feeling and its meaning before shifting to action.

sources.title: The Importance of Responding to Negative Affect in Psychotherapies
sources.quote: The therapist who tolerates such affect has the chance to understand it, help the patient understand it, and approach its resolution.
sources.technique: Stay empathically present with strong negative feelings instead of changing the subject; help the client put the feelings into words and understand them before moving toward resolution.
